svg.text: Terrain authoring — 2 / 4: blocks in the scenario editor (DESIGN_Terrain_Authoring.md §11, R-4199)
Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app.
aligned to the track (R to rotate)
The editor around it is unchanged context (dimmed). NEW: the title chip TERRAIN SOURCE (§14 E-2), block outlines, the placing ghost, the block menu and its Details.
• Placing: the ghost fits itself to the site as you move it — snaps to the nearest road, refuses water and buildings (B-3); click places ONE scenario entity (B-2).
• A placed block: Re-roll = a new seed, same place; Unpack = becomes its separate houses and features (frozen, no longer follows the recipe — B-Q1); one undo step each (B-6).
terrain items have no side — greyed while a terrain group is open
A house, two barns and a yard,
Every placement is a new layout
Add Entity — the SAME gallery (Add Entity Picker §2f); NEW are the six terrain groups at the bottom of the list (B-5), each a curated set (B-8).
A tile's picture is the recipe at its default seed, rendered by the existing thumbnail pipeline (§2j); the existing groups are unchanged context.
